description: Przystanki is a dataset listed in dane.gov.pl, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Zarząd Transportu Metropolitalnego. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2023-12-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dane-gov-pl.
